# Test fixtures

Everything here was written for Repackshot's tests and is under the project's licence (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0), like the repository. Nothing is
derived from another program's files or binaries.

| File | What it is | How it was made |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cube-two-groups.obj` | A cube of 20 with two groups (Caps, Body) and one `usemtl` | Written by hand (phase I1) |
| `tetrahedron.stl` | ASCII STL of a tetrahedron | Written by hand (phase I1) |
| `two-parts.fbx` | ASCII FBX 7.4: two Null groups (Assembly, Fittings), a box in each, one Phong material "Steel", `UnitScaleFactor` 1 (centimetres), `UpAxis` 1 (Y) | Written by hand from the public FBX ASCII layout (nodes, properties, `Connections`); no exporter was used |
| `cube.ply` | ASCII PLY: a cube of 20 units, 8 vertices, 6 quads | Written by hand |
| `two-parts.dae` | Collada 1.4.1: group Assembly with nodes Body and Cap, one Phong effect, `unit` inch, `up_axis` Z_UP | Written by hand |
| `two-parts.usda` | USD text layer: Xform Bottle with two meshes and one UsdPreviewSurface material, `metersPerUnit` 0.01, `upAxis` Y | Written by hand |
| `box.step` | STEP AP214 (ISO 10303-21): product Box, a 40 x 30 x 20 mm B-rep with six planar faces, colour `COLOUR_RGB` (0.8, 0.2, 0.1), millimetres (phase I2) | Written for the tests entity by entity from the public AP214 schema (contexts, product, `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP`, styled item); no CAD program or exporter was used |
| `box-inch.step` | The same structure: product Inch box, 2 x 1.5 x 1, no colour, length unit `CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('INCH')` | Same |
| `cylinder.step` | STEP AP214: product Cylinder, radius 10, height 30 mm, two planar caps and a cylindrical wall with a seam edge, no colour | Same |
| `assembly.step` | STEP AP214 assembly Bottle (`NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE`, `ITEM_DEFINED_TRANSFORMATION`) of Body (a 40 x 40 x 60 box, blue) and Cap (a cylinder of radius 12 and height 15, red) placed at (20, 20, 60) | Same |
| `quarter.igs` | IGES 5.3, 80 columns: one rational B-spline surface (entity 128) that is a quarter of a cylinder of radius 10 and height 20, a name property (406 form 15) "Quarter shell", colour number 2 (red), unit flag 2 (mm) | Written for the tests record by record from the public IGES 5.3 layout |
| `quarter-inch.igs` | The same surface with unit flag 1 (inches) | Same |
| `example.rsb` | The engine's example scene as RSB v1 (8768 bytes since E9 and E11 met: `RNDR` carries the pass mask of X2, the denoise strength of U11b and the pixel filter and edge samples of E11, `ENVR` the sky model of E5c, every `MATL` record is 100 bytes with the E6 bevel and the E9 medium and Abbe number): the byte-parity reference of `src/io/rsb.ts` (phase E4) | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-example tests/fixtures/example.rsb` |
| `e5.rsb` | The E5 parity scene as RSB v1 (10640 bytes since E9 and E11 met): glass, cut-outs, anisotropy, an HDRI and a background image, the byte-parity reference of the E5 fields of `src/io/rsb.ts` | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-e5-example tests/fixtures/e5.rsb` |
| `e9.rsb` | The E9 parity scene as RSB v1 (10816 bytes since the merge with E11): the E5 scene with a scattering medium (mean free path 4 mm, albedo 0.995/0.98/0.95, g 0.3) in its rough glass and, since E9c, a sphere of dispersive crystal (index 1.56, Abbe number 40) at the front right; the real `rt.wasm` must render it to `PINNED_E9_MEDIA_4SPP` (`tests/e9-materials.test.ts`) | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-e9-example tests/fixtures/e9.rsb` |
| `o1.rsb` | The O1 parity scene as RSB v1 (11656 bytes since E9 and E11 met: `RNDR` of 64 B, `MATL` of 100 B): the example at f/2 with six bokeh lights, seen through a lens with every knob of the enhanced thin lens and a 48 × 48 ring texture (the `LENS` section): the byte-parity reference of the `LENS` writer of `src/io/rsb.ts`, and with the real `rt.wasm` the image of `PINNED_O1_LENS_4SPP` | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-o1-example tests/fixtures/o1.rsb` |
| `o3a.rsb` | The O3a parity scene as RSB v1 (9436 bytes since E9 met it: `RNDR` of 64 B, `MATL` of 100 B): the example at f/2.8 with the six bokeh lights of O1, through a six-blade iris and a stack of three effect filters (black diffusion 1/2, a six-point star at 15°, a streak of 1/2: the filter slots at the end of `LENS`): the byte-parity reference of the filter slots of `src/io/rsb.ts`, and with the real `rt.wasm` the image of `PINNED_O3A_FILTERS_4SPP` | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-o3a-example tests/fixtures/o3a.rsb` |
| `o2.rsb` | The O2 parity scene as RSB v1 (10008 bytes since E9 met it: `MATL` of 100 B): the example at f/2.8 with the six bokeh lights of O1, seen through the double Gauss of the catalogue (`double_gauss_normal`, seven rounded blades) as a traced lens: the prescription at the end of `LENS`, the byte-parity reference of the prescription writer of `src/io/rsb.ts` | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-o2-example tests/fixtures/o2.rsb` |
| `e5b.rsb` | The E5b-1 parity scene (the E5 scene with 2048 caustic photons per sample) as RSB v1 (10640 bytes since E9 and E11 met): `tests/denoise.test.ts` renders it with the real `rt.wasm` | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-e5b-example tests/fixtures/e5b.rsb` |
| `e6.rsb` | The E6 parity scene (bevelled CAD-like parts: a two-tone box in two meshes, a metal cylinder, a thin plate) as RSB v1 (9852 bytes since E9 met it: `MATL` of 100 B): `tests/passes-engine.test.ts` renders it with the real `rt.wasm` the pool's way and must give the native pinned image and passes | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --write-e6-example tests/fixtures/e6.rsb` |
| `patterns.rsb` | The 13 woods and 12 fabrics of the catalogue as the interface sends them (phase E6): their `MATL` and `PATN` sections on a part of 100 mm, and a `NAME` section (`KEY\tLabel` per material, ignored by every reader but the sheet) — 6332 bytes since E9 met it (`RNDR` of 64 B, `MATL` of 100 B). `rt --pattern-sheet` renders the wood and cloth sheets from it (`--only wood` or `--only cloth` for one); `tests/patterns.test.ts` fails when it is not what the writer writes now | `REPACK_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 npx vitest run tests/patterns.test.ts` |
| `sky-physical.json` | The engine's physical sky (`rt_core::environment::sky_image`, f32) at 354 pixels of six skies, with the hash of the table it was made from: the preview's port (`src/core/sky.ts`) must give the same bits (phase E5c, `tests/sky-physical.test.ts`); a test of `rt-sky` checks it is current | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-sky -- fixture` |
| `lens-coc.json` | 18 cases of the circle of confusion of the thin-lens camera (the `coc` pass, phase X2): lens, depth, image size and the diameter in pixels that `cocDiameter` of `src/core/lens-coc.ts` gives (f64). The engine (`rt_core::passes::coc_diameter`, f32) must agree within 1e-5 (`engine/crates/rt-core/src/render/passes_tests.rs`) and lens-coc.ts exactly (`tests/lens-coc.test.ts`) | Cases written by hand; the last column computed with the formula of `src/core/lens-coc.ts` by a throwaway Node script |
| `passes-3x2.rpp` | The launcher's passes file (`RPP1`, phase X2) of a 3 × 2 image with every pass, each plane a formula of the pixel index (one floor pixel, one background pixel), render 42, 7 samples: `src/render/pass-planes.ts` `parsePasses` must read it as `engine/crates/rt-app/src/kept.rs` wrote it (`tests/passes-engine.test.ts`) | `REPACK_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p rt-app --lib kept` |
| `u1-render.json` | The `render` block of a project saved by U1 (schema 1): settings with `quality`, `maxSamples` and `maxSeconds`, and a queue of three flat jobs (done, running, waiting), one in EXR, the field set of U1's `RenderJob` (phase U5, migration test) | Written by hand from U1's types (`src/core/render.ts` before U5) |
| `project-v1.json` | A project exactly as U1 wrote it (schema 1: the state as it was, no `meshes` block, U1's flat render queue, `meta.dirty` saved as `true`): the bottle example with Copper on the cap, Rubber on four faces of the body, the Jewellery studio with Rembrandt, a second camera, the Hero animation, one queued render. It must keep loading in every version (phase U2, `tests/project.test.ts`) | `serializeProject` of commit `67b9154` (U1 closed) run on that project: `git archive 67b9154 src tests package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts` into a scratch folder with this repository's `node_modules`, and a test that builds the project through the store and writes `await serializeProject(state).text()` |
| `project-v2.json` | A project as phase U2 writes it (schema 2 with the `meshes` block): the imported box of `tests/project.test.ts` (UVs on the caps, two `usemtl` on the body = face ranges, hard edges), Gold on the caps, a linked copy of the body, a flipped caps mesh (a derived id), the Jewellery studio, a second camera, an animation, a queued JPEG render, a name. 19 kB | `REPACK_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 npx vitest run tests/project.test.ts -t "writes the fixtures"` (writes `buildBusyProject()` through `serializeProject`) |
| `host-protocol.json` | The messages between the page and the native window (P3c), both ways: every command the page sends with the JSON it becomes, and every message the window sends. `src/core/host-protocol.ts` and `engine/crates/rt-app/src/platform/protocol.rs` both pass it | Written by hand from the protocol table in `protocol.rs` |
| `ai-guard.json` | Five scenarios of the AI guard (phase X3a) on its synthetic scene (`engine/crates/rt-post/src/fixture.rs`, ported to `tests/ai-fixture.ts`): per scenario the hash of the delivered image, the hash of what the model was given and the report JSON. Native and `post.wasm` must give exactly this (`tests/ai-post-wasm.test.ts`) | `REPACK_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p rt-post` |
| `tonemap.json` | What the engine computes for 20 inputs: every tone curve, the sRGB encoding, the exposure gain and the 8-bit pixels of `Film::to_srgb8_tonemapped`; and `fmath`'s exp2, log2 and pow on 48 inputs (phase E4) | `cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p rt-cli -- --tone-table > tests/fixtures/tonemap.json` |

Files that are cheaper to build than to commit are generated inside the tests, so they are always what the
library of this version writes:

- `.3dm` (`tests/rhino-fixture.ts`): written with the `rhino3dm` package (openNURBS, MIT): four layers, three
  box meshes, one material, a hidden layer, a sphere B-rep without render meshes.
- `.3mf` (`tests/threemf-fixture.ts`): a stored zip (`tests/zip.ts`) with a minimal model: two objects with base
  materials, two build items, one of them with a transform.
- `.usdz`: a stored zip around `two-parts.usda`.
- Binary FBX (`tests/fbx-binary.ts`): the ASCII fixture re-encoded as binary at versions 7400 and 7500.
- Binary PLY, little and big endian, point clouds and damaged files: built in `tests/io-ply.test.ts`.
